Once the season is finished, this notice may be removed. Read at your own risk! Pugcasso is a masked celebrity contestant on the fourteenth season of The Masked Singer. Contents 1 Appearance 2 Songs 3 Clues 3.1 Clueless Clue 3.2 Spice Girls Clue 3.3 Care Bears Clue 3.4 Connection Clue 3.5 Crack The Case Clue Case 4 Final Guesses 5 Trivia 6 Gallery 7 Videos 8 References Appearance TBA Songs Week Song Selection Result 1 "Ordinary" by Alex Warren WIN 3 "Fake Plastic Trees" by Radiohead SAFE 7 "Too Much" by Spice Girls SAFE 9 "Dreams" by The Cranberries SAFE 11 "Bad Dreams" by Teddy Swims SAFE 12 "True Colors" by Cyndi Lauper SAFE "Sussudio" by Phil Collins RUNNER-UP "Home" by Phillip Phillips UNMASKED Clues Week Clues 1 “Well hello there my furry friends. I’m Pugcasso. And welcome to the Joy of Panting. Today, we’re going to paint a happy little career change. See, I was supposed to take over the family business. But sometimes you’ve got to color outside the lines. Like the time I threw my name in the hat on something big. My life changed overnight. I joined an ensemble of dreamers just like me, and before you knew it I went from nobody to top dog. Something only a handful of artists have achieved. Just like that, we painted success. But as for me, I’m still that ordinary pup living in an extraordinary world.” 3 “Coming from a small town, I thought I knew everybody. And then I saw her. Instantly my heart went boom. A few weeks later, I saw her again. Life was trying to tell me something, so I took my shot. And that was it. It was like a real life romcom. Cue the montage, guys. We were so in love. Until, I was asked to hit the road, and worse, to live a world away from my girl. Fast forward to when I got to the airport and there she was, with a suitcase in hand. And ever since then, when fame feels superficial, she keeps me grounded..” 7 “Spice Girls? Man they were lucky to have each other. Call me jealous spice, because there were many times where I was on my own, feeling mighty lonely. Like when I was in another country doing the biggest show of my life, surrounded by legends. Bruce Springsteen to my left, John Mayer to my right. And it was my turn to go on stage in front of hundreds of thousands of people. All by myself. And all I could think was… But the moment I stepped on stage, the entire stadium went wild. And sand along to every single word. Turns out I wasn’t alone. I had a hundred thousand voices joining mine.” 9 “Just like those Care Bears, I have all the feelings from making it this far. But Ken, I’m tired of watching you throw paint at the wall. I mean, you’re the sports guy. So, spoiler alert: This isn’t my first competition. I’ve even taken the Olympics by storm. I’m just trying to help.” 11 “There was a moment where everyone in America had their eyes on me. This hometown boy was thrown into interviews and photo shoots. The problem is, I’ve aways thought of myself as a musician, not a celebrity. I work really hard at a life as normal as possible for me and my family. I mean, my own kid doesn’t know that I’m famous. So you can imagine, I’d love to do the show, and I was lucky to be chosen. For me it’s about the art, the music. That’s why I want to make it to the finale. This has allowed me to do what I do best.”” 12 “This experience has been a roller coaster. I wasn’t sure what to make of this costume. A pug who paints? What even is that? I’m the guy who made a career out of performing with just a microphone and my guitar. After my first rehearsal, I was all turned around. I went back to my trailer and called my kids. They’re not used to their daddy being gone so long. Talking to them made me I needed to embrace this challenge. I spent so much of my career second guessing everything. The industry can rob you of so much joy. But where’s the best place to find it again? The Masked Singer! So, I decided to lean in and I’m a pug who paints, dangit! And I guess I even dance too. Tonight, the competition is on. I’m all in. For my kiddos.” Clueless Clue Clue Info Aloha shirt “I like the beach, and I like cameras.” Spice Girls Clue Clue Info “Rejected.” “Some people told me I wasn’t good at music. Luckily they weren’t good at their job either, so it all worked out in the end.” Care Bears Clue Clue Info Olympic torch “Being a part of the Olympics, it changed my life forever. I never imagined I’d have the whole world’s attention.” Connection Clue Relation Info Jenny McCarthy-Wahlberg “We have shared a stage together.” Crack The Case Clue Case Clue Info Golden Ticket delivered by BFF, Randy Jackson “It takes me back to the golden opportunity that started it all.” Clue Answers "The ticket was a nod to whemn Phillip was crowned the winner of "American Idol" in 2012" Final Guesses Week Robin's Guess Jenny's Guess Ken's Guess Rita's Guess 12 Justin Guarini Phillip Phillips Bo Bice Kris Allen Trivia The song "True Colors" is the song Kitty sang in Season 3.
